tools.hardware: NVIDIA GPU (CUDA): 9.7 GiB peak at 768 px, 4 views with kit/gpu/patches/mvadapter_11gb.patch (fits an 11 GB RTX 2080 Ti; gpu_check asks 10.8 GB free); about 14 GB unpatched or for more than 4 views; RAM not recorded (kit asks 12 GB)

tools.licence: Apache-2.0 (code); weights huanngzh/mv-adapter state no separate licence; base SDXL terms (CreativeML Open RAIL++-M) apply to its output
tools.fallback: sculpt.py shape from the one picture (Hunyuan3D-2.1), hand-drawn side/back views fed to sculpt.py shape --mv, or Tier 0 (catalogue, Blender)

tools.command: python kit/gpu/sculpt.py shape --mv | paint (kit/gpu/stages/shape_mv.py: Hunyuan3D-2mv shape from views; paint_mv.py: Hunyuan3D-2 paint from views onto the cage's UVs)
